name: Taskiq Open Source Distributed Task Queue
free_limit: MIT-licensed Python distributed task queue supporting synchronous and asynchronous jobs, worker processes, and pluggable Redis, RabbitMQ, NATS or Kafka brokers; no software-enforced task or worker quota.
watch_out: Self-host Python workers and configure a compatible broker and result backend; Redis/NATS/RabbitMQ/Kafka hosting, compute, monitoring and egress are not included. This is free software, not a vendor-hosted free queue or SLA.
